create_accelerator_options: create AcceleratorOptions with custom num_threads, device, and cuda_use_flash_attention2 settings
build_accelerator_device_enum: build an AcceleratorDevice enum value for cpu, cuda, mps, xpu, or auto device selection
validate_device_option: validate a device string against allowed options like auto, cpu, cuda, cuda:0, mps, xpu
configure_envvar_fallback: configure AcceleratorOptions to fall back to OMP_NUM_THREADS when DOCLING_NUM_THREADS is unset
set_cuda_flash_attention: set cuda_use_flash_attention2 to True to enable Flash Attention 2 on compatible NVIDIA GPUs
